description.default: Use Feishu (Lark) as a lightweight Snow App entry: drive a bound conversation from a private or group chat over the Feishu long connection, stream replies back, answer tool approvals and questions, and hand received images and files to the conversation.
description.zh-CN: 把飞书当作 Snow App 的轻量入口：用自建应用的 App ID / App Secret 建立飞书事件长连接，在私聊或群里下任务、看流式回复、批准工具授权与回答选择题，并把收到的图片与文件交给绑定会话处理。
description.zh-TW: 把飛書當作 Snow App 的輕量入口：用自建應用的 App ID / App Secret 建立飛書事件長連接，在私聊或群裡下任務、看流式回覆、批准工具授權與回答選擇題，並把收到的圖片與檔案交給綁定工作階段處理。
description.en: Use Feishu (Lark) as a lightweight Snow App entry: drive a bound conversation from a private or group chat over the Feishu long connection, stream replies back, answer tool approvals and questions, and hand received images and files to the conversation.

privacy.note: network 用于飞书长连接与 OpenAPI 调用；conversations 用于把聊天消息投递到绑定会话、新建会话与中止运行；messages 用于读取会话消息以做流式回推、读取待处理的工具授权与提问；toolApproval 用于把「批准 / 拒绝」回包写回本机待授权队列。凭证只经系统安全存储保存，不上传、不写入日志。
